Add to your home screen

If you don't see an install pop-up, add it from your browser's menu:

Samsung Internet
  1. Tap the menu button (three lines, bottom right).
  2. Tap Add page to.
  3. Tap Home screen, then Add.
Chrome on Android
  1. Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
  2. Tap Install app (or Add to Home screen).
  3. Tap Install.
iPhone (Safari)
  1. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
  2. Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

The app opens full screen, straight to today's devotion. Your Listen or Read choice and the days you mark as done are saved on your phone.
